name: Between Trips — Captain
source: KB: squid-on-board-binder / §4 Captain Boat Checklist — BETWEEN TRIPS
intro: Quick reset between AM and PM trips. Get the boat ready for the afternoon guests.

items.label: Close gate so guests don't board without assistance
Pull boat off dock to overnight position (so anchor doesn't beat up boarding steps)
Rinse off deck and benches if necessary, dry if needed
Discuss trip with mate, give feedback if necessary
Check rez software for afternoon roster, trip specifics
Return boat to boarding position and welcome afternoon guests 15 min prior to departure

completion.notes_prompt: Any issues from AM trip to address before PM? Anything to flag?
